ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with a large central low-intensity (black) region and distal high-intensity (white) lobes, ratio approximately 45:55.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black region centrally located at the fluke base. Large white regions on the lateral lobes. Distinct black focal spots: a group of three on the distal right lobe and two on the distal left lobe. Mottled black-on-white transition along the inner lobe margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 60 degrees; significant depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. High-amplitude irregular protrusions at both distal tips caused by biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a largely linear trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips with slight concavity near the terminal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular white pixel clusters (scars) visible within the central black pigmentation. Dense, dark, irregular clusters (barnacles) at both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct dark linear pixel disruption on the white ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific cluster of three dark circular markings on the white region of the right lobe.
